items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: But I enjoyed making the date with Jug.

ctx.x: with Gene Ammons, which was not that long after the period where you were playing way up high. You got into a different groove, you know.
Well, with Jug it was such a groove...I mean, to be able to get into another groove, you know. But I enjoyed making the date with Jug.

And then I'm always coming back to that date which I think is one of the great unsung dates, with Brew Moore and J.J. Johnson, because there you're playing very harmonically, intricate, very beautiful things...
